description_en: Queries the binding and expected configuration of a specified identity provider. If CustomSSO is configured with SAML, this operation reads back the actual upstream SSO configuration. The SCIM status is queried through a separate API operation
description_zh: 查询指定身份源的绑定和期望配置。CustomSSO 已配置 SAML 时回读上游实际 SSO 配置，SCIM 状态通过独立接口查询
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-identity-provider --workspace-id ws-123456 --identity-provider-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The external identity provider type. Valid values: DingTalk and Feishu
parameters.help_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

data.description_en: The binding details of the external identity provider
data.description_zh: 外部身份提供商的绑定详情

configuration.description_en: The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only in GetIdentityProvider. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual receiving status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

bindingType.description_en: The SAML binding type, which is HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. Required for manual entry. Queries return the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: The IdP entity ID. Required for manual entry. Must be non-empty and no more than 2,048 characters in length. Existing configurations cannot be changed. This is different from the entity ID of the service provider (SP) returned in queries
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The IdP logon URL. Required for manual entry. Must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

ssoStatus.description_en: The actual switch value, which is Enabled or Disabled. This is not equivalent to the expected loginEnabled value saved in AC
ssoStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled，不等同 AC 保存的 loginEnabled 期望值
ssoStatus.title_en: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态
ssoStatus.title_zh: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC format based on RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.description_en: The event subscription callback URL. You must configure this URL in the application of the external identity provider to receive organization change events. An empty string is returned if the user pool is not activated
eventSubscriptionCallbackUrl.description_zh: 事件订阅回调地址。需要将该地址配置到外部身份提供商的应用中用于接收组织变更事件，用户池尚未开通时返回空字符串

identityProviderType.description_en: The external identity provider type. Valid values: DingTalk and Feishu
identityProviderType.description_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu

loginCallbackUrl.description_en: The logon callback URL. You must configure this URL in the application of the external identity provider. An empty string is returned if the user pool is not activated
loginCallbackUrl.description_zh: 登录回调地址。需要将该地址配置到外部身份提供商的应用中，用户池尚未开通时返回空字符串

loginEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether workspace users are allowed to log on through the external identity provider
loginEnabled.description_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录

metadata.description_en: The application configuration of the external identity provider. Application secret configurations are not returned
metadata.description_zh: 外部身份提供商的应用配置。应用密钥类配置不会返回

appId.description_en: The App ID of the Lark application. Required when the binding type is Feishu
appId.description_zh: 飞书应用的 App ID。绑定类型为 Feishu 时必填

appKey.description_en: The AppKey of the DingTalk application. Required when the binding type is DingTalk
appKey.description_zh: 钉钉应用的 AppKey。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填

binding.description_en: The SAML binding URI in the historical metadata snapshot. To update CustomSSO, use saml.bindingType
binding.description_zh: 历史 metadata 快照中的 SAML Binding URI；CustomSSO 更新请使用 saml.bindingType

certificates.description_en: The certificate string in the historical metadata snapshot. To edit the configuration, use saml.x509Certificates and do not submit the old metadata
certificates.description_zh: 历史 metadata 快照中的证书串；编辑配置使用 saml.x509Certificates，不提交旧 metadata

corpId.description_en: The CorpId of the DingTalk enterprise. Required when the binding type is DingTalk
corpId.description_zh: 钉钉企业的 CorpId。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填

entityId.description_en: The IdP entity ID. Required for manual entry. Must be non-empty and no more than 2,048 characters in length. Existing configurations cannot be changed. This is different from the entity ID of the service provider (SP) returned in queries
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The IdP logon URL. Required for manual entry. Must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

protocol.description_en: The logon protocol. Only SAML is currently supported. This field may not be returned if no valid configuration is saved. OIDC placeholder initialization is not supported
protocol.description_zh: 当前仅支持 SAML；未保存有效配置时可不返回。不支持用 OIDC 占位初始化

saml.description_en: The SAML logon configuration. The input supports either XML or complete manual entry. Queries return the standardized configuration and do not echo the original XML. This field can be omitted if it is not configured
saml.description_zh: 输入支持 XML 与完整手填二选一。查询返回标准化配置，不回显原始 XML；未配置时可省略

bindingType.description_en: The SAML binding type, which is HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. Required for manual entry. Queries return the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: The IdP entity ID. Required for manual entry. Must be non-empty and no more than 2,048 characters in length. Existing configurations cannot be changed. This is different from the entity ID of the service provider (SP) returned in queries
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The IdP logon URL. Required for manual entry. Must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

x509Certificates.description_en: The list of IdP signing certificates. Required for manual entry. Must be a non-empty array using PEM X.509 certificate text. The current validity period is verified. A maximum of two certificates are allowed after deduplication
x509Certificates.description_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，去重后最多 2 张

items.description_en: A valid PEM X.509 signing certificate. The example is a public test certificate for idp.example.com. You must replace it with the certificate of the external IdP for actual integration
items.description_zh: 一张有效 PEM X.509 签名证书；示例为 idp.example.com 的公开测试证书，实际接入须替换为外部 IdP 的证书

status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:
CONFIGURED: The configuration is accepted and the system is waiting for the user pool to be activated.
SYNCING: Organization members are being synchronized.
SYNCED: Organization members are synchronized.
READY: The binding is in effect.
SYNC_FAILED: Organization member synchronization failed.
UPDATING: The configuration is being updated.
UPDATE_FAILED: Configuration update failed.
DISCONNECTING: The binding is being removed.
DISCONNECT_FAILED: Binding removal failed
status.description_zh: 状态。CONFIGURED（配置已受理，等待开通用户池）、SYNCING（正在同步组织成员）、SYNCED（组织成员同步完成）、READY（绑定已生效）、SYNC_FAILED（组织成员同步失败）、UPDATING（正在更新配置）、UPDATE_FAILED（更新配置失败）、DISCONNECTING（正在解绑）、DISCONNECT_FAILED（解绑失败）
status.title_en: 身份源资源及登录配置状态
status.title_zh: 身份源资源及登录配置状态

syncEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether organization member synchronization is enabled. After it is enabled, organization members are synchronized as workspace users by the external identity provider
syncEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户

syncScope.description_en: The configured synchronization scope, which follows the synchronization scope definition by department. If omitted during creation, the default value is AllAuthorized, and the first vendor synchronization is determined by syncOnBind. If omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. Updating and saving the scope does not automatically trigger full synchronization
syncScope.description_zh: 沿用按部门同步范围定义；创建省略默认 AllAuthorized，首次厂商同步由 syncOnBind 决定；更新省略或 null 保留原值，更新保存范围不自动执行全量同步

departmentIds.description_en: The list of department IDs. When the mode is SelectedDepartments, at least one non-empty department ID must be included, which should be obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. When the mode is AllAuthorized, pass an empty array or omit this field
departmentIds.description_zh: SelectedDepartments 时至少包含一个非空部门 ID，应取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments；AllAuthorized 时传空数组或省略

items.description_en: The unique identifier of the department returned by the identity source, which is obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments
items.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门唯一标识，取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments

mode.description_en:
The scope mode. Valid values:
AllAuthorized: All authorized scopes, subject to the application address book authorization limits.
SelectedDepartments: The selected departments and all their sub-departments.
When explicitly submitting syncScope, you must provide a valid mode, which is verified by the backend
mode.description_zh: AllAuthorized：全部授权范围，受应用通讯录授权限制；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效 mode，由后端校验

syncScope.title_en: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段
syncScope.title_zh: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last modification in UTC format based on RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
